kicad_symbol_check: pins 1 SDA, 2 SCL, 3 VDD, 4 VSS match ds p13

supplies.heater: up to 200 mW pulses, not used

logic: VIH 0.7 VDD, VIL 0.3 VDD; runs at the STCC4's 3.3 V

i2c_addr.bus: STCC4 controller port (not a brain bus)
i2c_addr.select: fixed by order code: -AD1B = 0x44, -BD1B = 0x45 (p15). The STCC4 needs 0x44.

placement: Opening centred on top; same vent as the STCC4, in the same air.
No copper under the part other than its pads; do not solder the centre pad (p12-13).
Away from heat sources; it sets the temperature reading of the whole device.
notes: -R2 (2,500 reel) is the stocked code; -R3 C2848306 (11,404, $1.85) is the same part on a bigger reel.
If a second, brain-readable humidity sensor is ever wanted on I2C_S, 0x44 collides with nothing else there only if the OPT4001 is strapped away from 0x44 (it is: 0x45).
